summary.text: Henry Stone is a Republican state representative for Iowa House District 9 and has served in the Iowa House since 2021.

paragraphs.text: The Iowa Legislature's 2023 biography lists Stone as a retired master sergeant in the U.S. Air Force who served overseas, including four deployments to the Middle East.
It lists degrees from the Community College of the Air Force, the University of Phoenix and Trident University, and says Stone was born in 1971 in South Korea and lives in Forest City.
